These are prior observations, not a claim that this proposed task has been executed. Screenshots are inapplicable: the checks concern artifacts, CLI reports and source/consumer references. - [ ] 1. Identify every Qt/SDK/plugin component actually used by the proposed strict profile and bind its exact source/package/build identity and notices.
- [ ] 2. Establish the applicable source/offer and redistribution disposition, or remove this SDK dependency through an explicitly pinned permitted alternative; unused artifacts are not silently declared permitted.
- [ ] 3. Retain reproducible build/configuration commands and source/tool hashes; keep binaries local and preserve component licenses.
- [ ] 4. Missing or changed dependency provenance refuses qualification or reports incomplete before a runtime scenario is credited.

This resolves dependency evidence only. Window/audio/focus qualification remains #14 and must keep the original hard constraints. A source build or alternative runtime is an investigation, not a pre-established solution.

The unchanged PAL SLES-517.05 corpus and AC01–AC32 in [the controlling specification](https://github.com/nicolas-found42/reverse-engineering/issues/5) are authoritative.
